description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ellakkala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510601
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
